causes.error: Incorrect bank, preference or term after switching
causes.cause: Fallback did not update bank/term memory; the generative path treated every named bank as a new preference and reused previous terms.
causes.fix: Shared preference merge; chosen bank distinct from queried bank; rejected bank list; independent chosen/query terms; explicit changes clear obsolete terms.

causes.error: Irrelevant offers in otherwise ordinary conversation
causes.cause: Prompt exposed every bank offer regardless of the current topic; final rendering did not exclude rejected banks.
causes.fix: Contextual fact selection, final rejection filter and contextual native other-card action.

causes.error: Hesitation or resuming lost sales intent
causes.fix: Persistent defer state, no premature checkout; product and preferences kept on resuming.

causes.error: Battery question lost the phone variant
causes.cause: Generic battery keyword took priority over the current product.
causes.fix: Technical follow-up uses exact current focus unless a different product is explicitly requested.
